title: Schedule of Remedies: Default, Cancellation and Builder Delay Figures — Home Purchase Agreement
content:
**Schedule D.** Cure periods, forfeiture caps, mutual release fees, refund periods, lot premium deposit refundability and builder delay terms of the Home Purchase Agreement, by collection.

| Collection | Cure period after default notice (calendar days) | Forfeiture cap on buyer default (% of contract price) | Mutual release fee (USD) | Refund issued within (business days after cancellation date) | Lot premium deposit refundable on other buyer cancellations | Builder delay tolerance (calendar days after contract completion date) | Calloway pays rate lock extensions caused by builder delay |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pathway Collection | 10 | 5.0 | 250.00 | 10 | No | 120 | Yes |
| Meadow Collection | 10 | 5.0 | 250.00 | 10 | No | 120 | Yes |
| Heritage Collection | 10 | 7.5 | 500.00 | 10 | No | 120 | Yes |
| Crestview Collection | 10 | 10.0 | 500.00 | 10 | No | 150 | Yes |
| Summit Collection | 10 | 10.0 | 750.00 | 7 | No | 180 | Yes |
| Reserve Collection | 10 | 10.0 | 1000.00 | 7 | No | 180 | Yes |

**Definitions used in Schedule D.**

1. *Cure period*: the calendar days after the default notice within which the buyer must cure.
2. *Forfeiture cap*: the cap on deposits Calloway retains on a buyer default, as a percent of the contract price.
3. *Mutual release fee*: the administrative fee deducted on a mutual release.
4. *Refund period*: the business days after the cancellation date within which a refund is issued.
5. *Lot premium deposit refundable*: whether the lot premium deposit is refundable on a buyer cancellation other than rescission or builder delay. It reads No in every collection.
6. *Builder delay tolerance*: the calendar days after the contract completion date after which the buyer may cancel for builder delay.
7. *Rate lock extensions on builder delay*: whether Calloway pays rate lock extension charges caused by a builder delay. It reads Yes in every collection.

**Illustration (hypothetical).** For a hypothetical Heritage Collection agreement with a contract price of 500000.00, a forfeiture cap of 7.5 percent is 37500.00; a mutual release fee of 500.00 applies to that collection, refunds are issued within 10 business days, and the builder delay tolerance is 120 calendar days.
